commercialPurpose: Convert a startup offer into scannable buyer benefits using a compact six-card proof grid.
purposeLayer: Features reduce uncertainty by listing concrete benefit claims after the opening offer.
anatomyLayer: Section heading, six light cards, circular line icons, short card title, and two to three lines of support copy.
hierarchyLayer: Section claim first, card icons second, card titles third, descriptions fourth.
gridRhythmLayer: Three-column by two-row card grid centered on a white section with equal gutters and restrained boxes.
densityLimitLayer: Use 3-6 primary modules; only use more when grouped by hierarchy.
originalityLayer: Learn six-benefit grid as a clarity device; transform icon style, card depth, copy grouping, and rhythm.
usageRuleLayer: Use for SaaS, startup, software, agency, service, and app landing pages after the hero or proof intro.
sectionSilhouette: center heading over two rows of equal feature cards
compositionTension: quiet symmetric grid follows a high-contrast hero
focalPath: heading to first row cards to second row cards
negativeSpaceShape: open white gutters around boxed modules
depthLayering: flat light card boxes with small icon badges
moduleScaleVariation: six equal modules with tiny icon emphasis
antiCopyBoundary: Do not copy exact icon set, card labels, coral/mint accent pairing, or grid measurements.

hyperAccuracyReceipt.reviewNotes: Checkpoint 002 is visually inspected learning evidence; keep incoming until exact hyper-accuracy review and dedupe rationale pass.
hyperAccuracyReceipt.nonCopyBoundary: Do not copy the exact Pallas editorial visuals, startup hero background, coral/teal color identity, photo assets, sidebar widget order, or footer treatment.
